تغتدون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَدُونَ (taḡtadūna) /taɣ.ta.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# تُغْتَدَوْنَ (tuḡtadawna) /tuɣ.ta.daw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
